title: Enter gets a current news banner
summary:
Enter’s news banner now pulls current highlights, with notices about model access, Kimi K2.5 Thinking, and payment options.

A “What’s new” banner was added to Enter’s home and sign-in pages. It pulls the three newest entries from the GitHub-hosted highlights file, replacing a disabled hard-coded banner.

The highlights and README now say that, starting January 30, `claude-large`, `gemini-large`, `veo`, `seedream-pro`, and `nanobanana-pro` require purchased Pollen. Free daily credits remain available for other models. This PR updated the announcement, not model eligibility.

The announcements also mention Kimi K2.5 Thinking and PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay via Stripe. This PR changed the news copy, not the model or payment implementations.
